summary: This is a 404 error page component that helps lost visitors get back on track. When someone lands on a missing page, it extracts a search term from the broken URL, automatically opens a search interface with that term pre-filled, and shows a playful meerkat-themed message along with buttons to go home or search the site.

explanations.12: This line extracts just the last part of the URL path (like 'docker-cs-fixer' from '/docs/tools/docker-cs-fixer'), filters out any empty parts, or returns an empty string if there's nothing to extract.
explanations.13: This replaces all dashes and underscores with spaces, turning 'docker-cs-fixer' into 'docker cs fixer' so it makes a better search query.
explanations.29: The useState with a function argument tells React to only calculate this random message once when the component first loads, not every time it re-renders.
explanations.37: This effect automatically opens the search palette whenever the extracted query changes, giving visitors instant access to search without them having to press a keyboard shortcut.
explanations.72: This lets users manually open the search palette with the same pre-filled query by clicking the button, in case the automatic opening didn't help them.
